instruction:
look at `/home/user/Desktop/vias.brd` in the EAGLE board editor. The board contains 8 vias, all drilled to `0.3 mm`. Shrink the three vias listed in `/home/user/Desktop/targets.txt` to `0.2 mm` drill and save the result as `/home/user/Desktop/answer.brd`.

Requirements:
- `/home/user/Desktop/answer.brd` remains a well-formed EAGLE 7.x board XML file.
- It still has exactly 8 `<via>` elements.
- The three vias at the coordinates listed in `/home/user/Desktop/targets.txt` have `drill="0.2"`.
- The other five vias still have `drill="0.3"`.
- Element, signal, and wire counts match the starter exactly; do not delete or reroute anything.

Only resize vias listed in `/home/user/Desktop/targets.txt`.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(15); pyautogui.hotkey('shift', 'tab'); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.press('enter'); time.sleep(1); pyautogui.press('enter')
